concerns.text: T001 implements dual-mode extraction (self + solute) citing an 'amended FR-001 (see T015)', but the authoritative spec still mandates 'ONLY ... diffusion_mode is "self"'. Although the execution order places T015 first, a task list cannot authorize its own spec amendment — the plan explicitly routed this through kickback ('The pipeline must not silently override the authoritative spec'). The amendment must land at spec stage before tasks encode it; otherwise T001 weakens FR-001 as written.

T003 writes engineered.csv 'without extra columns', moving electronegativity_diff and valence_electron_diff to a separate engineered_extra.csv. dataset.schema.yaml REQUIRES both fields in the curated dataset (required list), and T007 trains Linear Regression on all three feature columns from the engineered file. The split silently drops schema-required fields from the SSoT dataset and breaks T007's stated inputs.

Plan and data-model designate data/curated/filtered.csv as the Single Source of Truth validating against dataset.schema.yaml, and FR-008 explicitly requires baseline.py to calculate baseline_shift 'from data/curated/filtered.csv'. No task produces filtered.csv; T004 instead reads/writes engineered.csv/baseline_shifted.csv. This drops a spec-mandated artifact (FR-008) and breaks Constitution Principle IV traceability.

T007 specifies '≥1000 resamples' for the bootstrap CI, while the data model mandates 10,000 resamples with a percentile-inversion p-value procedure. The task silently relaxes a contract-pinned statistical requirement.

The spec's edge case requires an R² < 0.1 outcome to be flagged in the final report as 'Low Predictive Power - Null Result Hypothesis Supported'. Neither T009's validation_report.json field list (significance_verified, model_comparison, stability_target_met) nor T011's report description includes this flag — a dropped acceptance criterion.
